meaning.zh:
“请便” 或 “随意”。

这个短语的字面意思是邀请某人成为你的客人，所以在使用的时候带有一种礼貌和热情的邀请语气。它通常用于对某人允许或许可其做某事，同时表示毫不介意或欢迎对方的行为。
meaning.en: This phrase literally means to invite someone to be your guest, so it carries a polite and welcoming tone when used. It is commonly used to permit someone to do something, indicating that you don’t mind or you welcome their action.

lines.en: If you need to use my phone, *be my guest*.
lines.zh: 如果你需要用我的手机，请便。

lines.en: Would you like some of these cookies? *Be my guest*.
lines.zh: 你想吃些这些饼干吗？随意。

lines.en: Can I borrow your book? *Be my guest*.
lines.zh: 我可以借一下你的书吗？请便。
